major_pathologies: Highly repetitive fixture structure: each report uses nearly identical role counts, causal ordering, sentence forms, and mitigation cadence.
Distractors expose deterministic generation through repeated “Sample N was logged” and “Routine auxiliary trend” constructions.
Triac terminology is forced into every incident family, including contexts where it is peripheral or technically strained.
Some device behavior is implausible: a 12 ms residual triac-gate condition does not adequately explain minutes of continued AC conduction after current-zero crossings.
Several measurements appear reverse-engineered to satisfy narratives, with unexplained precision and weak derivational support.
The cooling fixture ambiguously combines a transmitter reporting 14 °C low with a controller described as seeing the true temperature, without identifying separate sensors or signal paths.
Reference summaries systematically omit material contributing causes and complications present in their semantic cores.
Cross-report reuse of ANSI 52/86 devices, independent channels, lockouts, calibration fixes, and verification steps creates conspicuous template fingerprints.
mutation_amendment: Vary incident topology, causal depth, role counts, chronology, prose form, and corrective-action type; require an explicit sensor-and-control signal map, independently recompute every duration and energy quantity, enforce component-specific physics, and reject any batch where one device motif or distractor sentence frame recurs across unrelated cases.
limitations: Assessment covers only the supplied fictional packet and does not establish similarity or equivalence to real incident data.
Scores are machine judgments, not human validation or engineering certification.
Some calculations and protection behaviors cannot be fully verified because equipment curves, ratings, schematics, and source records are absent.
